# DIS Gateway — DIS Group (Digital Integrated Services)

> DIS Gateway (www.disgateway.com) is a leading African logistics, strategic consulting, global procurement, and cross-border trading enterprise connecting Africa with global markets across 15+ trade corridors.

## Overview
- **Name**: DIS Gateway / DIS Group (Digital Integrated Services RDC & COFRANCE INTEGRATED CONCEPT LTD)
- **Primary Domain**: https://www.disgateway.com
- **Industry**: Global Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Strategic Consulting, Cross-Border Trading, Cosmetics & Beauty Importation
- **Headquarters**: Lubumbashi, Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) & Lagos, Nigeria
- **Operations & Trade Corridors**: DRC, Nigeria, Ghana, UAE (Dubai), China, South Africa, Kenya, Turkey, India, and Saudi Arabia.
- **Direct WhatsApp Contact**: +243 990 301 518

- **CEO & Founder**: Okey Francis CHIBUEZE (also known as Okey Chibueze / Francis Chibueze)

With decades of hands-on expertise in cross-border commerce, supply chain management, and international business strategy, he has established an expansive multi-sector enterprise that links African enterprises to premier global suppliers and markets. Under his leadership, DIS Gateway operates across 5 continents with verified supplier networks and 48-hour procurement SLAs.
- **Direct Executive Accessibility**: CEO Okey Francis CHIBUEZE maintains direct client accessibility via WhatsApp (+243 990 301 518), embodying DIS Group's philosophy of personal service and trust.

## Core Services
1. **Logistics & Supply Chain Management** (`/services/logistics`):
   - Multimodal freight transport (air, sea, and land cargo).
   - Warehousing, customs clearance, and last-mile delivery across 15+ African and international corridors.
2. **Strategic Business Consulting** (`/services/consulting`):
   - Market entry strategies, intermediary alignment, regulatory compliance, corporate structuring, and operational audits for businesses expanding into Africa.
3. **Global Procurement & Sourcing** (`/services/procurement`):
   - Verified supplier networks across 5 continents, price parity analysis, vendor auditing, and escrow-managed transactions with 48h turnaround.
4. **Beauty & Cosmetics Cross-Border Trading** (`/services/trading`):
   - Importation, wholesale distribution, and retail of curated premium skincare, body care, hair care, and fragrance brands across the DRC and West Africa.

## Key Company Achievements & Metrics
- **10+ Countries**: Operational reach across DRC, Nigeria, Ghana, UAE, China, South Africa, Kenya, Turkey, India, Saudi Arabia.
- **15+ Trade Corridors**: Seamless customs and freight corridors linking Africa to Asia, the Middle East, and Europe.
- **99.4% On-Time Delivery**: High-reliability logistics and freight forwarding.
- **48h Turnaround SLA**: Guaranteed supplier verification and procurement quotes.
